[#FFB7C5[]] [#FFF000[]]Mindustry Tool  [white[]]- The Ultimate In-Game Utility & Community Suite[[]]

[white[]]Mindustry Tool seamlessly connects your game to [#88C6ED[]]mindustry-tool.com[white[]], bringing thousands of community maps & schematics, cloud save synchronization, tactical combat overlays, and intelligent factory automation into one unified mod powered by the [#FFAEC0[]]Solim[white[]] reactive engine.

[accent[]] [#88C6ED[]]Community Hub & Cloud:[[]]
  [white[]] [#88C6ED[]]Content Browser:[white[]] Access a curated repository of [#394BA0[]]Maps[white[]] and [#D54799[]]Schematics[white[]] directly in-game.
  [white[]] [#FFB7C5[]]Cloud Save Sync:[white[]] Synchronize campaign saves, sectors, and schematics across devices.
  [white[]] [#FAA31B[]]Web Tools Suite:[white[]] Integrated access to mlog Logic Editors, Display Generators, Sorter Art, and Wiki guides.

[accent[]] [#FFF000[]]Automation & Factory Utilities:[[]]
  [white[]] [#FFF000[]]Autoplay AI:[white[]] Smart task management for building support, auto-repairs, and automated mining.
  [white[]] [#82C341[]]Smart Upgrade:[white[]] Instantly upgrade entire conveyor belts, conduits, and distribution chains with one tap.
  [white[]] [#FAA31B[]]Smart Drill:[white[]] Optimal drill positioning and resource coverage calculator for maximum yield.
  [white[]] [#88C6ED[]]Schematic Grid:[white[]] Rapid placement grid and hotkeys for effortless factory layout expansion.

[accent[]] [#EF4444[]]Combat Intel & Tactical HUD:[[]]
  [white[]] [#EF4444[]]Wave Preview:[white[]] Forecast upcoming enemy waves, unit tiers, flying/ground counters, and boss warnings.
  [white[]] [#FAA31B[]]Pathfinding Visualizer:[white[]] Real-time terrain overlay predicting enemy navigation paths and choke points.
  [white[]] [#82C341[]]Team Resource HUD:[white[]] Live core inventory tracking, real-time power grid balance, and consumption rates.
  [white[]] [#88C6ED[]]Range Display & Health Bars:[white[]] Customizable unit health bars and visual range circles for turrets and units.

[accent[]] [#009F75[]]Multiplayer & Global Chat:[[]]
  [white[]] [#009F75[]]Player Connect:[white[]] Easily create or join private peer-to-peer rooms with link sharing and ping monitoring.
  [white[]] [#88C6ED[]]Global Chat & Pretty Chat:[white[]] Connect across servers with stylized avatars, rank badges, and custom emoji picker.
  [white[]] [#82C341[]]AI Live Translation:[white[]] Instant multilingual chat translation powered by Google Gemini and DeepL.

[accent[]] [#FFAEC0[]]Camera, Audio & Quality of Life:[[]]
  [white[]] [#FFAEC0[]]Free Camera & Extended Zoom:[white[]] Detached smooth camera pan with unlocked macro and micro zoom ranges.
  [white[]] [#394BA0[]]Time Control:[white[]] Adjust game simulation speed (slow-motion, fast-forward, tactical pause) for testing.
  [white[]] [#FFB7C5[]]Music Player & Background Audio:[white[]] In-game audio player with custom tracks and background playback.
  [white[]] [#82C341[]]Performance Optimizer:[white[]] Toggle specific render passes (particles, lights, units) for huge FPS boosts.
  [white[]] [#EF4444[]]God Mode Suite:[white[]] Comprehensive sandbox toolkit for map testing and server administration.
